changeSet.author: landvault
changeSet.comment: The labels a receipt prints live in RLS-policied tables (plots, estates, blocks, organizations) and the confirmation runs with no tenant scope (a buyer's return page, or Paystack's webhook). SECURITY DEFINER, hardened like 043/047/054/088, and narrow: one succeeded payment, these columns only. The documents module can't read payments either (a module boundary), so the payment's own figures come back here too.
changeSet.sql: CREATE FUNCTION landvault_receipt_details(p_payment uuid) RETURNS TABLE ( transaction_id uuid, buyer_user_id uuid, seller_tenant_id uuid, amount numeric, currency varchar, channel varchar, last4 varchar, reference varchar, paid_at timestamptz, buyer_name varchar, seller_name varchar, seller_rc_number varchar, plot_id uuid, estate_id uuid, estate_name varchar, estate_area varchar, estate_city varchar, estate_state varchar, block_name varchar, plot_number varchar, plot_size_sqm numeric, is_corner boolean ) LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$ SELECT p.transaction_id, p.buyer_user_id, p.seller_tenant_id, p.amount, p.currency, p.channel, p.last4, p.reference, p.paid_at, trim(u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name), o.registered_name, o.rc_number, pl.id, e.id, e.name, e.area, e.city, e.state, b.name, pl.plot_number, pl.nominal_size_sqm, pl.is_corner FROM payments p JOIN transactions t ON t.id = p.transaction_id JOIN users u ON u.id = p.buyer_user_id JOIN organizations o ON o.id = p.seller_tenant_id JOIN plots pl ON pl.id = t.plot_id JOIN estates e ON e.id = pl.estate_id LEFT JOIN blocks b ON b.id = pl.block_id WHERE p.id = p_payment AND p.status = 'SUCCEEDED' $$; REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION landvault_receipt_details(uuid) FROM PUBLIC; GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION landvault_receipt_details(uuid) TO ${appDbUsername};

changeSet.author: landvault
changeSet.sql: WITH paid AS ( SELECT p.id, COALESCE(p.verified_at, p.paid_at, p.updated_at, p.created_at) AS issued_at FROM payments p WHERE p.status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND p.deleted = false ORDER BY COALESCE(p.paid_at, p.verified_at, p.created_at), p.id ), numbered AS ( SELECT paid.*, nextval('receipt_number_seq') AS seq, replace(gen_random_uuid()::text, '-', '') AS hex FROM paid ) INSERT INTO receipts (id, created_at, number, verification_code, payment_id, transaction_id, buyer_user_id, seller_tenant_id, plot_id, estate_id, issued_at, buyer_name, seller_name, seller_rc_number, estate_name, estate_location, block_name, plot_number, plot_size_sqm, is_corner, amount, currency, channel, last4, payment_reference, paid_at) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), now(), 'HT-RCT-' || to_char(n.issued_at AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Lagos', 'YYYY') || '-' || lpad(n.seq::text, 6, '0'), upper(substr(n.hex, 1, 12) || substr(n.hex, 18, 4)), n.id, d.transaction_id, d.buyer_user_id, d.seller_tenant_id, d.plot_id, d.estate_id, n.issued_at, d.buyer_name, d.seller_name, d.seller_rc_number, d.estate_name, NULLIF(concat_ws(', ', NULLIF(d.estate_area, ''), NULLIF(d.estate_city, ''), NULLIF(d.estate_state, '')), ''), d.block_name, d.plot_number, d.plot_size_sqm, d.is_corner, d.amount, d.currency, d.channel, d.last4, d.reference, d.paid_at FROM numbered n CROSS JOIN LATERAL landvault_receipt_details(n.id) d ORDER BY n.seq;
changeSet.rollback: -- receipts is never deleted by the app; a rollback of this changeset is a migration act. TRUNCATE receipts;
